title: Rate limiter never expires its window
prompt: src/limiter.js implements createRateLimiter({ limit, windowMs, now }) but it counts every call forever, so a key stays blocked once it reaches the limit. Implement a sliding window: only allowed calls inside the last windowMs milliseconds count, blocked attempts are not recorded, and keys are tracked independently. `now` is injected, so do not call Date.now inside check(). Do not edit the tests.
